tasks.title: Celeste and Brennan Whitford · 2025 Form 1040
tasks.description: Prepare the 2025 Form 1040 for Celeste and Brennan Whitford, married filing jointly in Washington, from 10 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Tie Celeste's HANGS W-2 and dividend to the company's own figures, itemize state and local taxes under the 2025 limit, mortgage interest and acknowledged gifts, tax the qualified dividends through the worksheet, add Additional Medicare Tax and the net investment income tax, test AMT and the underpayment penalty, and apply the child tax credit, withholding and the estimated payments the IRS credits to 2025. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an unsigned draft. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.

light.reason: Waiting for review: draft package ready, open items remain

tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an unsigned draft Form 1040 PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Unsigned draft, not reviewed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. Both spouses sign and a person files.
